And boids are a perfect example! Did you know Craig Reynolds’ original 1986 model used just *three* rules (separation, alignment, cohesion) to create lifelike flocking? And it turns out that many emergent systems, like flocking birds or schooling fish, have a characteristic information entropy that reflects their level of complexity. 🐟
